title: Patriot Place to open major indoor pickleball complex this fall - NewsBreak
text: FOXBOROUGH, Mass. (WWLP) – Patriot Place is expanding its footprint in the world of recreational sports with the addition of a 40,000-square-foot indoor pickleball facility. Slated to open this fall, the venue will complement the previously announced outdoor complex and establish a year-round destination for pickleball enthusiasts of all ages and skill levels. In partnership with ELEVENO Pickleball, the new indoor facility will feature nine professional-grade pickleball courts arranged around a central café and bar, offering counter service and courtside seating. Each court will be accompanied by its own lounge area with food and beverage access. In addition to gameplay, visitors can expect a full-service kitchen, quick-service food options, a Pro Shop, and private event space, making it a true hub for “eatertainment.” “We couldn’t be more excited to continue our partnership with ELEVENO and bring their vision of a premier pickleball and social hub to life,” said Brian Earley, Vice President and General Manager of Patriot Place. “Offering nine professional courts, an innovative food and beverage concept, private event space, Pro Shop and more, this new destination has something for everyone to enjoy as they hone their pickleball skills.” The indoor facility will be located in the space formerly occupied by Christmas Tree Shops in Patriot Place’s South Marketplace, adjacent to Trader Joe’s and RH Outlet. It will be open daily from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. Sunday through Thursday, and until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays. Jodi Cullity, Founder and CEO of ELEVENO Pickleball, emphasized the broader vision behind the project: “Pickleball is the anchor, but what we’re really building is a place people want to be. ELEVENO is a social hub where sport meets hospitality — where you can compete, connect, and enjoy great food and drink all in one place.” Players will be able to reserve court time, participate in training, and compete in tournaments. The indoor launch will follow the grand opening of the new 17,000-square-foot outdoor facility, which debuts in August during the third annual Patriot Place Pickleball Classic powered by ELEVENO.
